personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (Adapted for B2B Enterprise SaaS rigor)
personality_one_liner: A highly refined, command-center aesthetic prioritizing data density, tabular precision, and crisp native typography over decorative elements.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Bottom tab bar (when content scrolls behind it).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 1 iOS-Native Clean personality but modified for B2B SaaS density.
Implement tabular numbers using CSS 'font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums' or Expo equivalent for all financial values, telemetry, timestamps, and metric tiles.
Status Tags and Pills MUST be implemented as outlined badges (18% background opacity tint, 30% border opacity of the status color) to maintain a refined, non-competitive aesthetic.
Segmented Controls (e.g., P/A/L/E in Attendance) should have equal-width segments in a pill-shaped container. Active state gets an accent-tinted fill; inactive states remain neutral.

Timeline Rail (My Day / Schedule) should be a stable vertical list where the rail acts as a continuous decorative anchor. Each row stacks a headline, a status pill, a description, and a relative timestamp.
Ensure ALL numerical data arrays use monospaced or tabular proportional sans numerals.
Borders MUST be hairline (0.5pt to 1pt max) using the defined border colors. Maintain subtle shadow elevation rather than heavy borders for cards.
Avatars must fallback to initials centered in a tinted square/circle if no real PNG logo/photo is provided.
Ensure full Dark Mode support matching src/theme.ts, translating light backgrounds to deep near-blacks (#0D0E12) and inversing text/elevations properly without heavy contrast fatigue.
No emojis allowed anywhere in the system UI. No decorative charts or gradients. Maintain a cool neutral background with crisp light blue accents.
